title: WPSS/1639/2012 of MAHENDRA SINGH and OTHERS Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1639/2012
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr. Pankaj Tangwan, Advocate for the
petitioners.
 Mr. Rajesh Sharma, Brief Holder for
the State/respondents.
 Before the arguments could be
advanced, learned counsel for the
petitioners seeks permission to withdraw the
writ petition in relation to petitioner nos. 39
and 40 with liberty to file fresh petition.
 Permission granted.
 Writ petition is dismissed, so far
petitioner nos. 39 and 40 are concerned.
However, liberty is given to file fresh
petition.
 Heard learned counsel for the parties
and perused the record.
 Learned counsel for the parties
submitted that the controversy involved in
the instant petition is squarely covered by
the judgment of this Court in Writ Petition
No. 1048 (SS) 2010 'S.K. Duhan & others vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others', delivered
on 21.09.2012. They prayed that present
petition may also be disposed of in the light
of aforesaid judgment dated 21.09.2012.
 Considering the submission of learned
counsel for the parties and on going through
the record, the instant writ petition is also
allowed in the same terms and observations
made in Writ Petition No. 1048 (SS) 2010
'S.K. Duhan & others vs. State of
Uttarakhand and others', delivered on
21.09.2012. Impugned orders dated
24.10.2004 and 14.10.2010 are hereby
quashed. The respondents are directed to

make payment of the difference of pay
revision to the petitioners w.e.f. 01.01.1996
as recommended by the Vth Pay
Commission, within a period of six months
from the date of production of a certified
copy of this order.
 Interim relief application (CLMA No.
12411/12) also stands disposed of.
